verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents several ways to act on many items at once. DML statements update, insert and delete table data (bigquery-docs-2). The Storage Write API can batch an arbitrarily large number of records and commit them in a single atomic operation (bigquery-docs-121). Procedural language runs multiple statements with variables and control flow in one request (bigquery-docs-112). Scheduled batch transfers (bigquery-docs-41) and the scriptable bq CLI (bigquery-docs-49) round this out for automated use. missing for 10: explicit documentation of set-based DML updating or deleting many rows per statement, bulk operations across many resources (tables or datasets) at once, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows driven by an AI agent.
